## MGIT Hosts Expert Lecture on Industry Expectations from Graduating Engineers

News Date : 05 Feb 2026News ReportMGIT Hosts Expert Lecture on Industry Expectations from Graduating EngineersTheIndustry–Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC), in collaboration with theDepartment of Mechanical Engineering, organized anExpert Lecture on 05 February 2026at MGIT.The session was delivered byMr. Naveen G., Senior IEEE Member, Hyderabad Section, on the topic“Industry Expectations from Graduating Engineers – A Practical Insight: Student and Industry Perspective.”During the lecture, Mr. Naveen G. addressed thegap between academic preparation and industry requirements, drawing from real-world industry experience. He emphasized that in addition to sound technical knowledge, graduating engineers must developeffective communication skills, practical exposure, and adaptabilityto succeed in professional environments.The lecture provided students with valuable insights into current industry expectations and encouraged them to take a proactive approach toward skill development and career preparedness.The event contributed to strengtheningindustry–institute interactionand supported MGIT’s continued efforts to enhance employability and professional readiness among students.

## MGIT Hosts Expert Lecture on Industry Expectations from Graduating Engineers

TheIndustry–Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC), in collaboration with theDepartment of Mechanical Engineering, organized anExpert Lecture on 05 February 2026at MGIT.
The session was delivered byMr. Naveen G., Senior IEEE Member, Hyderabad Section, on the topic“Industry Expectations from Graduating Engineers – A Practical Insight: Student and Industry Perspective.”
During the lecture, Mr. Naveen G. addressed thegap between academic preparation and industry requirements, drawing from real-world industry experience. He emphasized that in addition to sound technical knowledge, graduating engineers must developeffective communication skills, practical exposure, and adaptabilityto succeed in professional environments.
The lecture provided students with valuable insights into current industry expectations and encouraged them to take a proactive approach toward skill development and career preparedness.
The event contributed to strengtheningindustry–institute interactionand supported MGIT’s continued efforts to enhance employability and professional readiness among students.
